shared_piece_prompt: Create one Princess Unicorn kingdom chess figurine in a consistent premium warm storybook set: soft painterly hand-painted board-game miniature, rounded friendly forms, tactile ceramic and painted wood, front three-quarter view, warm top-left key light, subtle cool rim, matching round star-embossed pedestal, full subject centred with generous padding. Preserve the classic chess silhouette at 80 px. Use a transparent/flat removable background with no floor, cast shadow, reflection, scenery, text, letters, numbers, watermark, weapons or extra figures. Faces and anatomy must be correct; every individually visible hand has five fingers.

handbook_story.prompt: The Bridge of Shared Light key moment: living versions of Queen Celestia, King Rowan, Sage Lumen, Comet and two Gleam Scouts place blue, gold and rose sparks together on a clover hill as Prism Vale's rainbow bridge returns. Preserve the approved Dawn figurines' faces, costumes, colours and warm top-left painterly light; landscape 4:3; correct five-finger hands; no pedestals, chess pieces, text or danger.
handbook_story.review: PASS: cast is recognisable from approved pieces; visible hands are anatomically coherent with five fingers; the shared-light restoration is one clear story moment; no text appears in the art.
handbook_story.processing: Master 1448x1086 PNG retained; deterministically resized to 1200x900 quality-85 WebP by chess-app/tools/build-handbook-assets.py.
